items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 11 June 2026 at 11:40am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds for a time this evening.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland with a frontal zone at first, which will clear for a time.


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 this evening. Becoming southwest 3 or 4 for a time overnight into tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, soon becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Rain soon becoming patchier, then becoming mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor in rain or drizzle, soon becoming good occasionally moderate.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, becoming 5 or 6 occasionally 7 for a time on Friday night into early Saturday daytime.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building mainly moderate for a time.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
